patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Rank Prompt and Zapier share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Rank Prompt only if your buying job matches “AI SEO and search marketing platform — affiliate partner in the AI category.” rather than Zapier's shape. Choose Zapier only if your buying job matches “Automation + AI — Free 100 tasks; Pro from $19.99/mo annual (750 tasks); Team from 2,000 t” rather than Rank Prompt's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Rank Prompt is shaped for AI SEO and search marketing platform — affiliate partner in the AI cat whereas Zapier is shaped for Automation + AI — Free 100 tasks; Pro from $19.99/mo annual (750 tasks. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Rank Prompt and Zapier share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Rank Prompt is AI SEO and search marketing platform — affiliate partner in the AI category.; Zapier is Automation + AI — Free 100 tasks; Pro from $19.99/mo annual (750 tasks); Team from 2,000 tasks; Agents add-on separate..
- Company-size focus: Rank Prompt (small-business, mid-market) vs Zapier (solo, micro, small-business).
- Researched limits: Rank Prompt — GEO/AEO niche — not general-purpose AI writing; Zapier — Task quotas (100 Free / 750 Pro) dominate TCO — multi-step Zaps burn tasks fast.

Limitations — Rank Prompt: GEO/AEO niche — not general-purpose AI writing; Zapier: Task quotas (100 Free / 750 Pro) dominate TCO — multi-step Zaps burn tasks fast; Agents add-on is separate from the Pro $19.99 floor.
